1.why: The UI uses a clean sans-serif face with clear headings, comfortable line-height in body paragraphs and monospace for codes, though log text is small and tightly wrapped.

2.why: No italics or all-caps are used and instructions are one-line sentences; the only dense text is the small monospace log block, which is not required reading.

3.why: The layout is a single centred column that would reflow, but the recovery-code list and the wide monospace secret/log panels overflow and wrap awkwardly at narrow widths, and no mobile viewport rendering is evidenced.

4.why: Each screen has one short plain-language sentence such as 'Generate backup codes and store them safely.'

5.why: The 'Authenticator code' field has no placeholder, hint or sample format showing what a six-digit entry should look like.

6.why: Every step proceeds from a single short sentence; nothing longer than one line must be read, although step 5 requires locating the code inside the log block.

7.why: No copy button or copy affordance is shown next to the Base32 secret or any of the eight recovery codes, so they must be transcribed by hand.

8.why: Step 3/4 explicitly says 'Use this manual Base32 secret' and offers no QR code or otpauth link alternative.

9.why: Email and mobile fields appear to hold prefilled values, but there is no visible evidence of autocomplete attributes or one-time-code autofill support on the OTP field.

10.why: The primary blue button and heading are prominent, but there is no step indicator or progress marker showing where the user is in the 5-step enrolment.

11.why: Each screen presents a single primary action, with only secondary options like 'Log out' or 'Regenerate codes' alongside it.

12.why: Confirmation appears mainly in the technical [SIMULATION] log lines and a 'MFA is active' end state; intermediate screens do not plainly state what just happened or what comes next.

13.why: 'Regenerate codes' and 'View recovery codes' exist and codes remain viewable, but there is no reveal/hide toggle or re-request of the authenticator secret.

14.why: No error or validation messages are visible anywhere in the 13 screenshots, so no evidence exists of blame-free, fix-oriented errors.

15.why: No countdown timer, expiry warning or session-timeout notice is shown, but neither is any explicit assurance of generous time, so this is inferred rather than observed.
